name: Felita Kealing
office: Pasadena Unified School District, Board of Education, District No. 1

items.text: Felita Kealing is an assistant coordinator of marketing, student recruitment and community relations and a candidate for the Pasadena Unified Board of Education District 1. She is a Pasadena Unified graduate and parent, and she helped establish the African American Parent Council and served on the Pasadena Educational Foundation board, including three years as president.

sentences.text: Felita Kealing is an assistant coordinator of marketing, student recruitment and community relations and a candidate for the Pasadena Unified Board of Education District 1.

She is a Pasadena Unified graduate and parent, and she helped establish the African American Parent Council and served on the Pasadena Educational Foundation board, including three years as president.

items.text: She has said the district’s closure of 11 schools over two decades has not produced satisfactory results. She feels ambivalent about closing more campuses and emphasizes boosting enrollment and attendance to strengthen district revenue. She also stresses cultural competency in the classroom so students feel respected and valued.
